philosophy: Preferences, not mandates. Prefer these. Override if clearly better. Propose alternatives for important projects (T2+). Never silently drop a favorite — the ADR must state why it was rejected. All listed tools are free to use (OSS or free tier) for personal and commercial projects without paid subscriptions.

tools.notes: Best compiler feedback loop for AI agents — strong type system catches bugs at compile time

tools.name: SurrealDB
tools.description: Multi-model: document + graph + vector + key-value in one engine. SurrealQL. Rust.
tools.when_to_use: When you need multiple data models in one engine (graph + doc + vector). Runs embedded (like SQLite), in WASM/browser, or as server. BSL 1.1 (converts to Apache 2.0 in 2030).

tools.name: Dgraph
tools.description: Distributed graph DB that auto-generates GraphQL APIs. Apache 2.0. Go.

tools.name: Neo4j Community Edition
tools.description: Most mature graph DB. Cypher. Native graph storage. GPLv3.
tools.when_to_use: When you need the most mature graph ecosystem, Cypher expertise, GDS library, or GraphRAG. CE = single instance, no clustering. GPLv3 is SaaS-safe (not AGPL).

tools.name: Memgraph
tools.description: In-memory graph DB, sub-ms multi-hop, Cypher, GraphRAG. C++.
tools.when_to_use: Real-time graph analytics, GraphRAG, when latency matters most. BSL 1.1 (converts to Apache 2.0 in 2030). In-memory — bounded by RAM.

tools.name: FalkorDB
tools.description: Graph DB using GraphBLAS sparse matrix math, Redis-compatible. Rust. SSPL-1.0.
tools.when_to_use: When you already run Redis, need ultra-low-latency graph traversal, Cypher queries. SSPL — fine for SaaS, can't offer as hosted service.

tools.name: GraphQLite
tools.description: SQLite extension for graph DB with Cypher, algorithms built-in. C.
tools.when_to_use: Embedded/local-first graph on top of SQLite. The only client-side graph option. 97.7% openCypher conformance. Built-in PageRank, Louvain, Dijkstra.

tools.name: ArangoDB
tools.description: Multi-model: graph + document + key-value in one engine. AQL query language. C++.
tools.when_to_use: When you want one database for graph + documents + key-value. BSL 1.1.
